prompts.vending: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game sprite, one isolated object. Primary request: a realistic modern compact beverage vending machine for an office. Tall slim cabinet, light silver powder-coated metal sides, charcoal glass front, a tasteful blue header strip with NO TEXT, clearly visible individually shaped colorful drink cans and bottles in four orderly shelves behind reflective glass, a narrow payment panel and small card reader on the right, a deep dark horizontal pickup tray near the bottom left and small rubber feet. The bottom pickup tray is visibly 18 percent above the floor. No branding, no writing. Camera: orthographic elevated RPG view looking down 30 degrees, exactly straight on, symmetrical verticals, NO isometric yaw, NO diagonal side view. Entire machine visible, including feet. Natural cabinet proportions height roughly 2.5 times width. Realistic polished 3D game rendering, visible depth in shelves, restrained glass reflections, soft upper-left light, clean strong silhouette that reads at 32x84 pixels. Fully transparent alpha background, no ground plane or cast shadow, no people or other objects, no outlines, no watermark. Center the object with ample transparent margins.

Convincing shelf thickness, slight wood grain on left, recessed back panels, soft shadows inside, subtle highlights on upper edges, little feet. Realistic polished 3D game render matching contemporary office furniture, clean strong silhouettes readable at 64x92 pixels, NO cartoon outline. Each whole bookcase completely isolated and centered inside its equal half of the image, generous transparent margins between them, no touching. Truly transparent alpha background, no floor, no cast shadow, no labels, book titles, writing, watermark, people, or extra objects.

Simple readable believable geometry matching polished realistic 3D office game props, soft light upper left, crisp silhouette designed to be read when the side sprite is 44x32 pixels and front/rear 28x40 pixels. Each whole bicycle separately centered inside its equal grid cell with generous transparent margin and no overlap. Front view must show front wheel centered nearest camera; rear view rear wheel centered nearest camera, saddle nearest viewer and handlebars beyond. Truly transparent alpha background including INSIDE wheels and between frame tubes; no background plane, no cast shadow, no rider, no stand, no text or logos or watermark.
